question: Find the compound interest on ₹7,000 at 9% p.a. for 1 year 8 months, compounded annually.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate for the 1st year = 9%

Rate for the next 8 months = 9% × (8/12) = 6%

Effective CI rate for 1 year 8 months = 9 + 6 + (9 × 6)/100 = 15.54%

Total Compound Interest = 15.54% of ₹7,000 = ₹1,087.80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,087.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 9% p.a.

Time (T) = 1 year 8 months = 1 + (8/12) years = 1 + (2/3) years

**Formula Used:**

When time is in a fraction like n + a/b years:

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ × [1 + (R × a/b)/100]

Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount (A) = 7000 × (1 + 9/100)¹ × [1 + (9 × 2/3)/100]

⇒ A = 7000 × (109/100) × (1 + 6/100)

⇒ A = 7000 × 1.09 × 1.06

⇒ A = 7000 × 1.1554 = ₹8,087.80

⇒ CI = Amount − Principal

⇒ CI = 8087.80 − 7000 = ₹1,087.80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,087.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

When interest is compounded annually, the total amount is calculated as A = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ, where P is the principal, R is the rate of interest, and n is the time in years.

Effective Rate of Interest

For two different continuous time periods with rates a% and b%, the combined effective rate is given by the successive percentage change formula: Effective Rate = a + b + (a × b)/100.

Compounding Half-Yearly

When the interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate of interest becomes half (R/2) and the number of time periods becomes double (2n).
